title: Fourth amendment: audio-frame input timeline (channel-coherent mono playback at the device rate)
frozen_before: any reevaluation or measurement under the corrected input timeline

supersedes.note: Additive. Original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256, amendments 1/2/3, all correction contracts, receipts and generated WAV bytes are preserved byte-for-byte.

reason: Directly observed input-timeline bug: InputGen::fill advanced the shared WAV position inside the channel loop and ignored the WAV sample rate. Stereo advanced the mono source twice per audio frame, and a 48 kHz fixture played fast on a 96 kHz device. The default long scenario's nominal 120 BPM truth was therefore wrong and cannot be corrected after measurement.

required_mapping.frame_position: One source position per audio frame, independent of channel count. Advance by numSamples device frames ONCE, after all channels are filled.
required_mapping.interpolation: Fractional source positions use bounded deterministic linear interpolation with wrap; mono is replicated coherently into every channel. No undisclosed per-channel gain.
required_mapping.clock: Absolute uint64 device frame begins at 0 and continues across cold and warm blocks without reset; source-clock advance is independent of channel count (1 or 2).
required_mapping.exactness: 48->48 is exact identity; 48->96 halves the source index step; a noninteger 48->44.1 ratio is supported and tested.
required_mapping.outside_rt: Input generation and resampling run outside the armed processBlock region. WAV bytes are loaded and hashed off-callback; nothing is read from disk inside the armed region. The real processor still receives the full device-rate buffer.
required_mapping.default_fixture: The long default-backend scenario uses the explicitly hashed synthetic 120 BPM fixture (or a true 120 BPM builtin in device time), never a block-reset pseudo-random envelope labelled as that rhythm.
required_mapping.builtin_clean: Built-in clean is a true deterministic 120 BPM pulse/harmonic strum in device time t=(deviceFrame+i)/deviceRate with a 0.5 s period and exponential decay, shared across channels with no per-channel random advance and no per-block phase reset.
required_mapping.builtin_noise: Noise advances the LCG once per FRAME and replicates the value across channels (declared); it is a uniform nonrhythmic control, not a tempo source.
required_mapping.invalid_inputs: A WAV with a non-positive/non-finite sample rate is rejected; an invalid device rate is rejected before playback (no divide-by-zero).

verification.pure_tests: ReplayInput.h is shared by the harness and the support self-test: mono/stereo equal phase; source advance is N not 2N; 48->48 and 48->96 index steps; noninteger 44.1 ratio; repeated wrap; a ramp WAV at fs=4/device=8 gives the exact wrapped interpolation sequence; a realistic fs=48 impulse every 24000 samples lands at device frame 24000 at 48 kHz and 48000 at 96 kHz; chunk invariance (128 vs 64+64); builtin clean absolute-time phase; deterministic noise per frame.
verification.metadata: Each cell/identity/scenario declares inputSignalKind, inputSourceRate, deviceRate and channelMapping additively; the original 54 expected cell ids and the nominal clean 120 truth are unchanged in meaning (playback now correct).
verification.preserve: make_synthetic_evidence.py WAV byte generation is unchanged; the generated canonical four-WAV manifest and hashes are preserved. Earlier tool pins are preserved; a new tool pin 4 and receipt are new files.

gates.note: structural AND rt_gate AND join_gate; default no-lock remains diagnostic.
